class.name: GroundMarks3D
class.brief_description: Marks left on the ground where it goes: tire tracks, footprints, ski tracks.
class.description: While [member emitting], it lays a mark on the surface below it every [member spacing] it moves: a continuous strip with [constant MODE_STRIP] (tire tracks, ski tracks), or separate stamps with [constant MODE_STAMPS] (footprints, hoof prints). Each lies on the ground found by a ray down [member ground_distance], turned along the way it moves, and fades out over the end of its [member lifetime]. Off the ground, the strip breaks. The body it's on isn't counted as ground. Turn [member emitting] on when the marks should be left: a car's wheel while it skids, a foot while it's planted. Draw them with a [member material] whose texture is the mark (a tire's tread, a footprint), with its albedo from vertex color so they fade; without one, they're plain dark marks. They stay put when [WorldOrigin] shifts the world.

method.name: clear
method.description: Takes all its marks away at once.

method.name: get_mark_count
method.description: How many marks it has down now.

members.member: The physics layers the ground is found on.
If [code]true[/code], it leaves marks as it moves.
How far below it the ground is looked for, in meters.
A stamp's length along the way it goes, in meters.
Seconds a mark lasts, fading over the last part of it.
What the marks are drawn with: UVs run across a strip and along it once per [member width], or across each stamp. Use albedo from vertex color for them to fade. Without one, plain dark marks.
The most marks there are at once: past it, the oldest go first.
Whether it leaves a strip or stamps.
How far it moves between marks, in meters.
How wide a mark is, in meters.

constants.constant: A continuous strip: tire tracks, ski tracks, a sledge's runners.
Separate stamps along the way: footprints, hoof prints.
